The Dutch '''[[Eredivisie]] in the 1994–95 season''' was contested by 18 teams. [[AFC Ajax|Ajax]] won the championship without losing a game. Starting this season, clubs qualifying for the [[Intertoto Cup]] can play for a spot in the [[UEFA Cup]].

This was the final season in which two points were awarded for a win; going forward this changed to [[Three points for a win|three points]].

==Promotion/relegation play-offs==
